courses.title: Mind-Body Life Coaching and Mentoring for Workshop Leaders
courses.description: One-to-one sessions with Ken by phone or Zoom. The life coaching is self-directed inner exploration for working through worry, old beliefs and difficult decisions, and the mentoring helps holistic workshop and group leaders find their calling and make their teaching more transformational. A free 20-minute introductory call is offered.

flags: Restored under the new health rule: the page offers to 'free yourself from anxiety and worry' and 'heal trauma' through self-directed coaching; it is life coaching, not psychotherapy, and makes no claim to treat a medical condition. Sessions are sold through his store; no price is shown on the coaching page, so 'Contact for pricing'.
